answer.rationale: 'Dj Poema beat' (Sweden, DJ, Urbankiz/Tarraxo) and 'Poema Beatz' are a spelling variant of one distinctive stage name with a DJ prefix, and both sides are tied to Sweden: the A side is Swedish-only while the B side's Swedish flag appears on the same name across many events, including the Swedish event 15260 and the Swedish-linked event 15557, so the spelling variant and shared Swedish country support one artist.
